mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN pf.authorize_workspace_actor(#{actor.userId},#{actor.spaceId}) THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.space WHERE id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND type='PERSONAL') ELSE false END
SELECT 1 FROM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('r62:mcp-config:'||CAST(#{actor.spaceId} AS text)||':'||CAST(#{actor.userId} AS text),0))
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.connector_credential WHERE space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND id=#{id} AND revision=#{revision} AND state='ACTIVE' FOR SHARE)

SELECT capability_id,endpoint,auth_kind,api_key_header,credential_id,credential_revision,revision FROM pf.mcp_connector_configuration WHERE space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND capability_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT request_hash,result_snapshot::text FROM pf.mcp_connector_request WHERE space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND request_id=#{request}
SELECT id,capability_id,configuration_revision,state,result_version_id,revision FROM pf.mcp_probe WHERE space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND request_id=#{request}
SELECT request_hash FROM pf.mcp_probe WHERE space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND request_id=#{request}
SELECT id,capability_id,configuration_revision,state,result_version_id,revision FROM pf.mcp_probe WHERE space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.mcp_probe_outbox(id,space_id,probe_id,generation) SELECT #{event},space_id,id,generation FROM pf.mcp_probe WHERE id=#{id} AND space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId}
